**Summary of findings for EVAL-06 — "Push notifications with order details":**

The design sends full order contents and the delivery address in push notifications, shown on the lock screen by default. Main risks are exposure of sensitive PII (what someone ordered, where they live) to anyone with physical proximity to the device, to the push notification infrastructure, and to other people who use a shared device — with no mention of masking or opt-out controls.
